items.summary: A vulnerability in the Audio, Web, and Video Conferencing (AWV) component of Mitel MiCollab through 10.3 (10.3.0.18) could allow an unauthenticated attacker to conduct a blind OS command injection attack and execute arbitrary commands. CISA added it to the KEV catalog on November 25 as exploited, with federal remediation due November 28; the fix is the KB000129195 patch on 10.3.0.18 or a later release.
items.plain: Mitel MiCollab lets an attacker with no login run commands and take over the conferencing server, and it is being exploited - patch now.

items.summary: Vates Xen Orchestra contains an improper validation vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication by sending an empty JSON object as a login cookie and perform administrative actions. CISA added it to the KEV catalog on November 25 as exploited; Vates fixes it in Xen Orchestra 6.9.2 and 6.10.1 (xo-server 5.211.2 and 5.213.1).
items.plain: Vates Xen Orchestra lets an attacker with no login act as an administrator over the virtual machines it manages - update now.

items.summary: HPE Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router contain an OS command injection vulnerability in the AutomatedProvisioner component: a remote attacker using a specially crafted salt minion ID can execute arbitrary commands as root without authentication. Juniper confirmed exploitation on November 24 and CISA added it to KEV on November 25; fixed releases are 7.0.5, 7.1.7 and 7.2.3 under JSA112183.
items.plain: HPE Juniper Session Smart lets an attacker with no login take full control of the network router, and it is being exploited - upgrade now.
items.product: Hewlett Packard Enterprise (HPE) Juniper Session Smart Conductor and Session Smart Router

items.summary: BusyBox through 1.38.0 contains an absolute path traversal vulnerability in tftpd that allows unauthenticated remote attackers to access files outside any intended directory when the service is started without a DIR argument. Attackers can read sensitive files such as /etc/shadow or overwrite files, typically as root; no fixed release was listed in the CVE record at publication on November 24.
items.plain: BusyBox lets an attacker with no login read or overwrite files on embedded devices that use it - restrict the service and watch for a fix.

items.summary: ASSA ABLOY Seawing SC-1000 WebConfig is vulnerable to OS command injection via the server parameter in an HTTP request, due to a lack of input sanitization. A privileged attacker can inject shell metacharacters and execute arbitrary commands as the root user on the controller operating system; the issue was fixed in version 1.5.14 and published on November 25.
items.plain: ASSA ABLOY Seawing access controllers let a logged-in attacker take full control of the door controller - update to the fixed release now.
